# .github/workflows/runtime-install-lint.yml via the runtime-install-lint action's

# / `nix shell nixpkgs#…`) because their runners carry no baked Nix toolchain.

# line here. A NEW workflow that adds a per-job nix-installer is NOT in this
# baseline → it FAILS the gate (the forcing function that keeps the count falling,
# never rising). Entry format is the lint's own offending-file path (./-prefixed).
